changes.position_motion: Nearest-player speed from positions over +/-0.08 s, rejecting >15 m/s; same implementation on all sources. Collective speed remains the frozen calibration's +/-0.48 s feature.
changes.contact: Experiment 005 cue: complete original ball observations, +/-0.12 s velocity change 3..10 m/s, proximity envelope 1.2 m, bounded evidence. No transition discount.
changes.gap_memory: Carry only verified control memory across unobserved ball frames, exponentially decaying over the existing 2.5 s live / 0.35 s dead times. Do not infer a new owner from missing observations.
changes.speed_guard: When ball speed is unknown, cap instantaneous close-control weight at 0.5; unknown speed is not evidence for a slow ball.

evaluation: Development only, full physical matches and official metrics, separate matched phases under 2 s, all variants once with fixed parameters. Baseline receives the same position-based collective movement as the final submission, provider nearest-player speed. Compare a separately captured original model as an exactness check.
stress: Separate robustness check, not a selection set: seed 606, start a 25-frame missing-ball burst with probability 0.01 per frame. Clear ball and ball-relative distances/speeds together. Retain all other observations and references unchanged; no synthetic XY noise. Never use target labels to decide missingness. This is artificial observation deletion, not evidence of transfer to the competition tracker.
promotion: No automatic change to the submitted default. Experimental candidate requires positive mean spellF1 and no per-game spellF1 loss; D recall and macroF1 losses no greater than 0.02 and 0.005. Even a passing development result requires fresh independent games for a generalisation claim.
stopping_rule: No threshold sweeps or retuning after scores. Preserve failed variants and their results. Do not score competition labels or consumed final tests.
